name: TreeList
description: Virtualized nested tree navigation with flattened visible branches and fixed row heights.

accessibility.selection: aria-selected and aria-activedescendant on rendered row; collapsing an ancestor of the selection reanchors to the nearest visible ancestor and emits cu-change
accessibility.keyboard: Arrow keys, Home, End, Enter and Space
accessibility.disabled: Disabled rows cannot be selected or expanded

performance.requires: Fixed row heights and stable unique value strings
performance.reuse: Overlapping row nodes reused within the current window; scroll and resize coalesced via requestAnimationFrame; pending frame cancelled on disconnect.
performance.inputSafety: Repeated objects/keys skipped in visible traversal, depth limited to 100, initial expansion supports id and path fallback.
